ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STREET & CITY
184
STUDY 111
Light Blue Zip Shirt & Pleated Skirt
Rights check
Source: 25003.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, light blonde hair
and a hair clip wears a pale blue crinkle-texture zip shirt
with a pointed collar and small heart pulls, layered over
a white pleated mini skirt with two black belts. A silver
pendant necklace and a clear pearl choker complete
the look. Her expression is calm. A casting board and a
dark curtain behind her. Palette of powder blue, white,
and black. Soft and playful, in the style of a
behind-the-scenes Y2K lookbook.
Soft, playful, layered
WORKING NOTES
- The double belts and pearl choker are the layered
details.
- Keep the casting board for an editorial setting.
